description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — creates an entity (e.g. a seat) under a customer, tied to a feature. Autumn API: POST /v1/entities.create.

billing_controls.description: Optional billing controls for the entity (spend/usage limits).

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to create the entity for.

feature_id.description: The ID of the feature this entity is associated with.
